findings.title: Invalid -ms-align-items vendor prefix in align-items mixin
findings.body: The align-items mixin includes `-ms-align-items: $alignment;` which is not a valid CSS property. The correct IE-prefixed property for align-items is `-ms-flex-align` (which is already present on the previous line). This declaration is silently ignored by all browsers and should be removed.

findings.title: Removed bullet badge margin-top may cause vertical misalignment
findings.body: The `&.bullet { margin-top: 5px; }` rule nested under `.extra-info-wrapper .badge-wrapper` was removed. This 5px top margin was used to vertically align the bullet-style category badge with the surrounding title text in the topic header. Without it, the bullet badge now sits flush at the top of `.extra-info-wrapper` instead of being offset to align with the title baseline, causing a visible vertical misalignment in the rendered topic list.

findings.title: Dead float declarations remain on flex children in .contents
findings.body: Lines 43-44 (`float: left` on `.login-button, button.sign-up-button`) and line 54 (`float: left` on `.icons`) still declare floats on elements whose parent `.contents` is now a flex container. In flex containers, the `float` property on children is computed but ignored, so these declarations are dead code. The same applies to the `button { float: right }` rule at topic-post.scss line 309 and `float: left` on `.topic-avatar` at topic-post.scss line 270, whose parent `.small-action` is also now a flex container. The `clear: both` at the end of `.small-action` likewise has no effect in a flex context. These declarations should be removed to avoid confusion about the actual layout mechanism.
